notes.title: Server maintenance announcement (2025.01.08)
notes.notes:
Hello, this is MeowLabs.
We are notifying you of the scheduled server maintenance.

Date: 2025.01.08 08:00 ~ 16:00 (KST, GMT+9)
Reason: Server migration
Impact: Unable to access all websites operated by MeowLabs,
Ranking registration/checking unavailable,
server connection failure message displayed when running the game (game play is possible)

We will not provide a notice of maintenance completion.
The maintenance schedule may change, and if a reason occurs, we will notify you through the official [url=https://www.instagram.com/MeowLabsKR]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://x.com/MeowLabsKR]X(Twitter)[/url].

Thank you.

notes.title: v2.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Team Infinity.
OVER ROAD has been updated to version 2.0.1.
For comfortable play, please be sure to update on Steam before playing.

Changes:
- Fixed a bug where the player's animation was stuttering in the last stage.
- (English) Inconsistent word selection has been unified.
- (Linux / Steam Deck) Fixed a bug where cutscenes would not play.

Thank you.

notes.title: About how to play on Steam Deck
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Team Infinity.
OVER ROAD does not officially support controllers (gamepads), [b]but can be played on Steam Deck.[/b]

For detailed instructions on how to play, see below.

Movement: L stick
Aiming: Right Touchpad
Dash/Special Control: A Button

Thank you.
